elements.requirement: Section 33 of the relevant Act, which concerns miscellaneous duties of a prison governor, ceases to have effect.
elements.quote: Section 33 of that Act (miscellaneous duties of prison governor) shall cease to have effect

elements.requirement: Rules made under section 39 of the relevant Act may permit the governor of a prison to authorise an officer of the prison, or a class of such officers, to exercise on the governor's behalf such of the governor's functions as specified by the rules.
elements.quote: Rules made under section 39 of this Act may permit the governor of a prison to authorise an officer of the prison, or a class of such officers, to exercise on his behalf such of the governor’s functions as the rules may specify

elements.requirement: Section 39(1) of the relevant Act is amended to insert the words ' or any other enactment ' after the word 'Act'.
elements.quote: in subsection (1), after “Act” there shall be inserted “ or any other enactment ”

elements.requirement: Section 39(8) of the relevant Act is amended by substituting the words ' any purpose specified in the rules ' for the words 'the purpose so specified'.
elements.quote: in subsection (8), for “the purpose so specified” there shall be substituted “ any purpose specified in the rules ”

elements.requirement: Rules made under section 39 of the relevant Act may confer functions on a governor, without prejudice to the generality of subsection (1) of that section.
elements.quote: Rules made under this section may (without prejudice to the generality of subsection (1) above) confer functions on a governor
